description: Deterministic context injection map for C1a, revision r2 (supersedes r1; r1 stays frozen as the 2026-09-07 baseline record). Per category: keywordPatterns select it, contextNodes are DB KnowledgeNodes (unchanged from r1), contextDocuments are reviewed repository Markdown sections supplied as in-memory, never-persisted context. Selection (AskContextBuilder): each pattern matches only as a whole word or phrase (an optional plural s/es is allowed); a category scores the summed word count of its distinct matched patterns plus its optional boost when anything matched; the highest score wins, ties go to declaration order, zero means no category (standard word-overlap retrieval). Documents: path is relative to the docs root and must sit under the AskContextBuilder allowlist; section is a GitHub-style heading anchor; audience is household (any authenticated role) or administrator (ADMINISTRATOR only; every other role, including no role, receives nothing from that entry). The default audience is administrator.
